title: English Every Day
summary: Ama and Carlos share simple habits that help them practise English every day.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama and Carlos sitting on a sofa with headphones and a notebook, a bright living room, no text

sentences.text: Hi Carlos! Welcome to our show about learning English.
Thanks, Ama. Today we talk about small daily habits.
I think habits are more important than long lessons.
I agree. I study for only fifteen minutes every morning.
What do you do in those fifteen minutes?
I read a short article and write three new words in my notebook.
That is a great idea. I like to listen to songs.
Do you understand the words?
Not always, but I look up the new words later.
Do you ever sing along?
Yes, I sing in the shower! My neighbours are not happy.

quiz.q: How long does Carlos study each morning?
quiz.explain: He says he studies for only fifteen minutes every morning.

quiz.q: What does Carlos write in his notebook?
quiz.explain: He reads an article and writes three new words.

quiz.q: What does Ama like to do?
quiz.explain: Ama says she likes to listen to songs.

sentences.text: Ama, I am sometimes afraid to speak because I make mistakes.
Everybody makes mistakes, Carlos. That is how we learn.
But people may laugh at me.
Most people are kind. They want to help you.
Do you have any advice for me?
Start with a friend. Talk about your day for five minutes.
That sounds easy. Maybe I can call my cousin in Canada.
Perfect! He can correct you gently.
And after the call, I will write down the new phrases.
Good plan. Come back and tell us how it goes.
I will. Thanks for listening, everybody!

quiz.q: Why is Carlos afraid to speak?
quiz.explain: He is afraid because he makes mistakes.
Carlos plans to call his cousin in Canada.

quiz.q: What will Carlos do after the call?
quiz.explain: He says he will write down the new phrases.
